mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_return(code, req_id, batch_id, qty, applicant_id, status, return_time) VALUES(#{code}, #{reqId}, #{batchId}, #{qty}, #{applicantId}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_return WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{dayPrefix}, '%')

SELECT sr.*, ua.nickname AS applicant_name, uc.nickname AS confirmer_name FROM stock_return sr LEFT JOIN sys_user ua ON sr.applicant_id = ua.id LEFT JOIN sys_user uc ON sr.confirmer_id = uc.id WHERE sr.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY sr.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_return WHERE status = 0

SELECT sr.*, ci.name AS chemical_name, ua.nickname AS applicant_name FROM stock_return sr LEFT JOIN chem_batch cb ON sr.batch_id = cb.id LEFT JOIN chem_info ci ON cb.chemical_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ua ON sr.applicant_id = ua.id WHERE sr.status = 0 ORDER BY sr.create_time ASC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_return SET status = 1, confirmer_id = #{confirmerId}, confirm_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE stock_return SET status = 2, comment = #{comment} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
